Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The South Africa players are out in the middle. Mohammad Rizwan and Babar Azam will open the innings for Pakistan. George Linde will start the proceedings for South Africa.

Right then. 189 needed to win. Pakistan have the tools necessary for them to win this game but it will depend on how South Africa bowls as well. It is building up to be a mouth-watering run chase. Join us for the same shortly.

Mohammad Hafeez is down for an interview! He says that he is happy that he is playing his 100th T20I game. Adds that South Africa have put up a good score on the board. Mentions that the bowlers did well to restrict South Africa under 200. Further says that they are confident of chasing this total.

The bowling by Pakistan was good to start off with, but they lost their way in the middle overs. But towards the end, when it looked like South Africa would go big and end up with 200-plus on the board, they came back strongly and denied them the opportunity to do so. The pick of the lot were two bowlers - Mohammed Nawaz and Hasan Ali. Both of them were economical and also had 2 wickets to their name. Shaheen Afridi, who is usually reliable, was tonked all over the park. Overall though, they will be pleased with this display.

This has been a brilliant batting display by the South Africans! They started off slowly as they lost 2 quick wickets as Malan, who was looking good, could not continue and Lubbe, went back for a very low score. Markram was looking very solid and he kept going about his business and he did not want to stop for anyone. He also got to his fifty and stitched a 62-run stand, with the skipper, before Aiden departed. The skipper, Klaasen though was in a fiery mood and went onto score his 50, in just 28 balls. It was at this point that the Pakistani bowlers did well to keep picking the wickets and dried up the runs, which saw the hosts end up with 188.
SIX! Magala finishes the innings in style! Full on middle, Magala lofts it over long on for a maximum. SOUTH AFRICA END WITH 188/6!
PLAY AND A MISS! Good length delivery outside off, Magala looks to swing at it but misses it.
Full and outside off, Phehlukwayo drives it through covers for a run.
FOUR! Nice improvisation! Low full toss on off, Phehlukwayo plays a reverse scoop over short third man for a boundary.

Yorker on middle, Phehlukwayo pushes it towards the off side for a run.

Full on middle, Linde flicks it towards long on for a single. Only 6 runs off this over.

We are all set to begin. The Pakistan players are out in the middle. Aiden Markram and Janneman Malan will open the innings for South Africa. Shaheen Afridi will start the proceedings for Pakistan.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Janneman Malan, Aiden Markram, Heinrich Klaasen (WK/C), Wihan Lubbe, Pite van Biljon, George Linde,  Andile Phehlukwayo, Sisanda Magala, Beuran Hendricks, Lizaad Williams, Tabraiz Shamsi.
Pakistan (Playing XI) - Babar Azam (C), Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Fakhar Zaman, Mohammad Hafeez, Haider Ali, Mohammad Nawaz, Faheem Ashraf, Hasan Ali, Shaheen Afridi, Usman Qadir, Haris Rauf.
TOSS - It is time for the spin of the coin. South Africa win the toss and elect to bat first!

Hello and welcome to the first T20I between South Africa and Pakistan in Johannesburg. The hosts would look to start the series with a win, after suffering a loss in the ODI series. They are without a lot of their star players as some of them have gone to the Indian T20 League and their skipper, Temba Bavuma is injured and hence, Klaasen will be leading the side. The hosts would look to improve their bowling from the ODIs. On the other hand, Pakistan would look to continue its winning momentum from the ODIs. They have a strong batting line-up too and this will be a good place to find their optimum eleven. An exciting encounter is on the cards. Stay tuned for the toss and the teams.
